name: ECDAT Enterprise Master Cryptographic & Post-Quantum Policy
description: Comprehensive enterprise cryptographic governance policy defining mandatory controls across algorithms, key sizes, protocols, certificates, PQC readiness, environments, and business units with deadline-based enforcement.
author: ECDAT Cryptographic Governance Board

rules.name: Prohibit Cryptographically Broken Hash and Cipher Algorithms
rules.description: MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC2, RC4, and Blowfish are mathematically vulnerable and strictly prohibited across all environments.
rules.remediation_guidance: Migrate collision-vulnerable hashes to SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-3 and legacy ciphers to AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

rules.name: Minimum RSA Key Size Enforcement (Production)
rules.description: RSA keys with fewer than 2048 bits are vulnerable to factorization and strictly blocked in production.
rules.remediation_guidance: Rotate RSA keys to a minimum of 2048 bits immediately, or ideally 3072/4096 bits or transition to Ed25519 / ML-DSA.

rules.name: BFSI & High Assurance Key Strength Policy
rules.description: Regulated BFSI applications require minimum RSA-3072 and ECC-256 bits.
rules.remediation_guidance: Upgrade cryptographic keys in BFSI applications to RSA-3072+ or ECC P-256/P-384/X25519.

rules.name: Prohibit Insecure Protocol Versions
rules.description: SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are deprecated by RFC 8996 and prohibited in production.
rules.remediation_guidance: Disable legacy protocol versions in TLS terminator and require TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

rules.name: Prohibit Self-Signed Certificates in Production
rules.description: Self-signed X.509 certificates break chain of trust and are blocked in production environments.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace self-signed certificates with certificates issued by an authorized enterprise or public CA.

rules.name: NIST CNSA 2.0 Quantum Resistance Mandate with Phased Deadlines
rules.description: Mandates adoption of post-quantum cryptography (FIPS 203 ML-KEM, FIPS 204 ML-DSA, FIPS 205 SLH-DSA) with warning phase transitioning to hard blocking by 2030.
rules.remediation_guidance: Implement hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519+ML-KEM-768) and prepare firmware/software signing for ML-DSA-65/87.

rules.name: High-Assurance Authentication Service Security
rules.description: Core identity and authentication applications require AES-256 and FIPS approval.
rules.remediation_guidance: Upgrade cryptographic modules in identity provider to AES-256-GCM and FIPS-validated implementations.
